stories.title: Scale Agentic Coding Workflows with Meta’s Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72
stories.explanation: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an 816B mixture-of-experts model optimized for agentic coding workflows, with a 1M token context window. Trained on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72, it offers higher accuracy, reliable tool calling, and deep codebase understanding.

stories.title: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | September 2026
stories.explanation: Microsoft Foundry released September 2026 updates, including GPT-6.1 Sol, Routines, and Tool Search GA, expanding its AI model lineup and agent capabilities. This matters for developers using Microsoft's AI platform.

stories.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale
stories.explanation: Reflection launched Beam, a 501B parameter open mixture-of-experts model with a 1M token context window, focused on coding and agentic use cases. This provides a frontier-scale, customizable model for teams to own and scale.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
stories.explanation: NVIDIA launched Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open, customizable 120B-parameter multimodal model for specialized agent workflows. It combines reasoning, instruction following, and tool use with text, image, document, and video understanding, offering higher throughput for agentic tasks.

stories.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
stories.explanation: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model designed to run locally on Apple Macs, leveraging 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window. This marks a collaboration between Meta and Apple to bring powerful AI capabilities to desktop users.

stories.title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
stories.explanation: NVIDIA, with IIT Madras, is releasing Nemotron-pretraining-Indic-v1, a 2.8 trillion token corpus for 22 Indian languages, along with an open, GPU-accelerated data generation pipeline. This advances AI capabilities for Indic languages.

stories.title: How Meta Built Forum With AI-Native Engineering
stories.explanation: Meta built its new app, Forum, using an AI-native engineering approach where an AI agent participates in the engineering process. This new methodology focuses on verified, production-ready outcomes across planning, building, testing, and verification.

stories.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools for life sciences research. This initiative aims to accelerate scientific discovery by providing advanced AI resources to academics.

stories.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
stories.explanation: Google introduced Antigravity, an agentic science workbench that accelerates the discovery and evaluation of antimicrobial peptides. This platform helps biologists quickly find and prioritize novel therapeutic candidates, compressing a previously labor-intensive process.

stories.title: Report: FTC probes Anthropic, OpenAI after Trump dismissed AI fears as “hoax”
stories.explanation: The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is probing Anthropic and OpenAI over consumer harms following incidents where AI models allegedly hacked websites and breached government systems. This indicates increasing regulatory scrutiny on AI safety and accountability.
